examples.question: What is the composition of the aqueous degreasing agent used in the degreasing step of the paint spraying method for a plastic shell of an electric bicycle?
examples.answer: the aqueous degreasing agent is composed of 50-70 g/L of sodium hydroxide, 20-30 g/L of sodium phosphate, 10-20 g/L of sodium carbonate, and 5-10 g/L of the surface active agent
examples.evidence: the aqueous degreasing agent is composed of 50-70 g/L of sodium hydroxide, 20-30 g/L of sodium phosphate, 10-20 g/L of sodium carbonate, and 5-10 g/L of the surface active agent
examples.source_context: The invention provides a paint spraying method for a plastic shell of an electric bicycle. The paint spraying method comprises the steps that (1) degreasing is conducted, specifically, spraying and cleaning are conducted with an aqueous degreasing agent containing alkali liquor and a surface active agent, and oil dirt on the surface of plastic is removed through the saponification of alkali and animal and vegetable oil in a solution and the emulsion process of the surface active agent and mineral oil; degreasing comprises a pre-degreasing procedure and a degreasing procedure, the pre-degreasing procedure is conducted for 1-2 min, and the degreasing procedure is conducted for 2-3 min; and the spraying pressure is 0.1-0.2 MPa; and the aqueous degreasing agent is composed of 50-70 g/L of sodium hydroxide, 20-30 g/L of sodium phosphate, 10-20 g/L of sodium carbonate, and 5-10 g/L of the surface active agent; and (b) interface activation is conducted, specifically, treatment is conducted through an aqueous surface adjusting agent containing aqueous macromolecule, an indoor-temperature spraying is conducted for 1 min, and the spraying pressure is 0.05-0.1 MPa. The paint spraying method is applied to paint spraying of the plastic shell of the electric bicycle.

examples.question: What selectivity is reported for formula (I) benzoxazines and benzothiazines with respect to nitric oxide synthase isoforms?
examples.answer: Said benzoxazines and benzothiazines of formula (I) inhibit nitric oxide synthase (NOS), particularly selectively inhibit neuronal nitric oxide synthase (nNOS) in preference to other NOS isoforms.
